descriptionMd: SCAN 2026 Finals brings together the Top 20 teams from the Online Qualifier for an in-person CTF in Seoul, Korea. Finalists will compete in digital asset tracing, blockchain investigation, and security challenges for a total prize pool of 2 BTC.
